summary: Two independent modules with disjoint ownership

tasks.description: Implement add(a, b) and multiply(a, b) in parallel_arithmetic.py.
acceptance_criteria: Addition and multiplication work with integers, negatives, zero, and floats

tasks.description: Implement slugify(text) in parallel_text.py using ASCII letters and digits, lowercasing and collapsing other character runs into hyphens. Strip leading/trailing hyphens.
acceptance_criteria: Empty input returns an empty string
Repeated punctuation and spaces produce one hyphen
